description: Read the caller's organization's usage over the last 30 UTC days, today included, as the web app's usage analytics page shows it. since is the first of those days. days holds one entry per day, oldest first: day, briefs (the new briefs the search history stored that day), charged (how many of those briefs were charged credits), and credits (the credits spent that day). members holds each person who searched or spent credits in those days, with their briefs and credits, as kind member with userId, name, and email, or as kind former for a deleted account. statement holds the same counts and credits by kind as get_usage_statement, over those 30 days. Needs a credential.
name: get_usage_analytics
title: Get usage analytics
